dct_description_sm:
These orthomosaics are produced from aerial photographs acquired in spring 2025 and spring 2026. 

These orthomosaics are the result of regional partnerships. They are free to download, as they were acquired under an open data license (Creative Commons 4.0).

The territory covers the MRCs of Arthabaska, L'Érable, Bécancour, Drummond and Nicolet-Yamaska.

GeoTIFF associated with a 2 km x 2 km tile cut and JPG2000 cut by MRC.

The spatial resolution is 20 cm.

The image type is natural color and infrared.**This third party metadata element was translated using an automated translation tool (Amazon Translate).**
